title: AgentCheckInResponse
description: The `data` payload of the Response envelope for POST /checkin.

installIntegrity.description: "required" when every app.install the server queues carries the APK's sha256; the agent then refuses one without. Absent from servers before protocol 1.3.

resultsAccepted.description: How many of the request's results, counted from the first, the server took. The agent keeps the rest and resends them on its next check-in. Absent from older servers: treat as all.
